verdict.rationale: dlt itself is a data-loading library without a built-in scheduler, but docs show it can be deployed on orchestrators like Airflow/serverless functions, and the dltHub platform explicitly offers a 'dlthub deploy' command to 'Schedule, refresh, backfill, and observe runs' of pipelines. This covers recurring-job automation but depends on external orchestration tools or the managed dltHub add-on rather than native scheduling in dlt core. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of the dltHub scheduling feature working, and details on native cron-like scheduling within dlt itself.
